title: ACIM Slip Speed Estimator
source_docs: Motor Control Blockset HDL Support/Controls/Control Reference/ACIM_Slip_Speed_Estimator.md
text: Calculate slip speed of AC induction motor, 2 inputs, 1 output; {Number of pole pairs}, {Rotor resistance (Ohm)} sets the rotor resistance of motor, {Rotor leakage inductance (H)} sets the leakage inductance of rotor winding, {Magnetizing inductance (H)} sets the magnetizing inductance of induction motor, {Output saturation (rpm)} sets the saturation value for the block output, {Input units} sets the unit of input values Per-Unit and {Base speed (rpm)} sets the base speed for per-unit system. Values come from the instance.

ports.name: ⍵ m slip
ports.summary: Slip speed of induction motor scalar

params.name: Number of pole pairs
params.values: Number of pole pairs available in motor 2 (default) | scalar

params.name: Rotor leakage inductance (H)
params.values: Leakage inductance of rotor winding 6.81e-3 (default) | scalar

params.name: Magnetizing inductance (H)
params.values: Magnetizing inductance of induction motor 30e-3 (default) | scalar

params.name: Output saturation (rpm)
params.values: Saturation value for the block output 150 (default) | scalar

params.name: Input units
params.values: Unit of input values Per-Unit (PU) (default) | SI Units

params.name: Base speed (rpm)
params.values: Base speed for per-unit system 1500 (default) | scalar
